 Blue Jackets at Blackhawks projected lineups
 By 
 NHL.com 
 @NHLMedia 
 November 19, 2026 
 Link copied 
 BLUE JACKETS (7-12-0) at BLACKHAWKS (6-13-2) 
 8 p.m. ET; CBJHN, CBJNHL, CHSN 
 Blue Jackets projected lineup 
 Matthew Knies -- Luca Del Bel Belluz -- Kent Johnson
 Ryan Lomberg -- Adam Fantilli -- Valeri Nichushkin
 Cole Sillinger -- Charlie Coyle -- Mathieu Olivier
 Isac Lundestrom -- Jack Williams -- Steven Lorentz
 Zach Werenski -- Damon Severson
 Ivan Provorov -- Denton Mateychuk
 Jake Christiansen -- Erik Gudbranson
 Cam Talbot
 Jet Greaves
 Scratched: Dante Fabbro, Dmitri Voronkov 
 Injured: Conor Garland (upper body), Sean Monahan (upper body) 
 Blackhawks projected lineup 
 Roman Kantserov -- Anton Frondell -- Tyler Bertuzzi
 Oliver Moore -- Frank Nazar -- Patrick Kane
 Jordan Greenway -- Ryan Greene -- Teuvo Teravainen
 Andrew Mangiapane -- Ryan Donato -- Dillon Boucher
 Alex Vlasic -- Sam Rinzel
 Ian Cole -- Artyom Levshunov
 Wyat Kaiser -- Ethan Del Mastro
 Spencer Knight
 Drew Commesso
 Scratched: Kevin Korchinski 
 Injured: Connor Bedard (right shoulder) Bowen Byram (upper body) 
 Status report 
 The Blackhawks held an optional morning skate … Bedard, a forward, will miss this game and at least three more on the upcoming road trip to Calgary, Vancouver and Seattle. Coach Jeff Blashill said the team is discussing the options of surgery or therapy … Lundestrom returns to the Columbus lineup after missing the team’s first 19 games because of a lower-body injury.
